harness.scope: DSH scripts and goal gates; no Wip.Factory production code

baseline.pricing: deepseek-flash rates pinned at 2026-11-11; peak/off-peak UTC calendar

mechanisms.implementation: DSH compaction and tool-result-pruner packages; the new session-budget projection bounds a per-turn working view and keeps the full transcript retrievable

mechanisms.requirement: separate historical evidence from active context
mechanisms.implementation: work-state reconstructs declared/effective status from the durable session and evidence store; session-budget reports per-turn facts separately from the full archive

mechanisms.requirement: reconstruct context from durable state at meaningful boundaries
mechanisms.implementation: goal/session projections and work-state rebuild state from the session log and revalidated evidence store; session-budget emits a context pack with source digests and seq locators
spill locators and bounded output views keep full output retrievable; session-budget emits turn-level seq locators
compaction facts carry a source label and bounded fact block; session-budget projection binds the source log SHA-256 and projection SHA-256

mechanisms.requirement: instrument token usage, cache utilization, model calls, retries, tool calls, wall time and cost
mechanisms.implementation: session-budget measures all named counters from canonical session events, marks absent usage unknown, and prices with pinned rates; session-trace and acceptance-ledger provide the goal trace and cost ledger

mechanisms.requirement: detect repetitive or stalled execution loops
mechanisms.implementation: the repeat-tool-reminder guard injects a bounded reminder for consecutive identical calls; delegation progress tracks stagnation; session-budget reports repeated-call groups and stalled turns offline
the frozen prior-session archive is the baseline; its full SHA-256, event counts, usage and bounded projection are recorded in DSH_EFFICIENCY_BASELINE.json and reproduce from one command

mechanisms.requirement: refuse goal completion when required engineering deliverables are missing
mechanisms.implementation: engineering-deliverables-gate returns a synchronous GoalCompletionCheck; a missing, empty, escaping, malformed or status-mismatched artifact blocks the real goal service and commits nothing

tool-subagent rejects config the provider cannot apply (agentOptions, agentPreset, depthLimit, outputSchema) and model selection validates the live session route; tests cover mount-time and request-time refusal

commands: pnpm exec vitest run scripts/work-state.spec.ts scripts/session-trace.spec.ts
verification.reproduceBaseline: node --import tsx/esm scripts/session-budget.ts --session C:/Users/ricar/.dsh/sessions/--F-dev-Modus-WIP--/session-6d38d16b-2c7e-4d5d-9b24-0c8fefbdef6f --out DSH_EFFICIENCY_BASELINE.json --markdown DSH_EFFICIENCY_BASELINE.md --context-pack DSH_CONTEXT_PACK.json

limitations: The bounded projection is a diagnostic working view, not a claim that the same 515-call session would have completed with 1,187 tokens.
Offline loop detection reports repeated call signatures and failed repeats; it does not replay a model and cannot prove that a future loop would have been prevented.
Cost is computed from pinned public rates and recorded usage; it is not provider billing and is null when any response lacks complete usage.
The prior session archive is a frozen local artifact; its SHA-256 is recorded, but the archive itself is not copied into the repository.
DSH changes are in a separate checkout and commit ef7cb1377d; the pre-commit hook could not run in this environment, so lint/typecheck were run directly (tsc exit 0).
